system.description: Risky. You plant a boot in a foe's chest and spring away. Test Agility (DR14) against a foe within reach. On a success, it takes d8 damage and is pushed 15' away, and you leap 15' the other way without provoking Opportune Attacks.

outcomes.failure: Half damage, and you leap away, but it is not pushed.
outcomes.ruin: Your heel slips: you are Prone at its feet.
